Organization, time management, communication, and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet publishing and development deadlines. items.description: Job Description : About the role Regal Realms is a growing UK property and short-term rental business seeking an experienced full-stack developer in Islamabad or Rawalpindi to take ownership of an existing business dashboard. Some of the dashboard has already been built. Your initial responsibility will be to understand the existing work, establish what is working, complete unfinished features, and make the platform reliable and easy for the team to use. The dashboard covers business operations, tasks, property information, reporting, and finance-related workflows. An upcoming feature will track payments from booking platforms, identify missing payments or unexplained deductions, and provide a clear follow-up process. Responsibilities Review and take ownership of an existing web application. Complete and improve dashboard features and user workflows. Connect business tools, APIs, and data sources. Build practical automations that reduce manual administration. Add clear payment tracking and reconciliation workflows. Job Specification : Strong practical experience with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Experience with Supabase or PostgreSQL, including database design, authentication, and role-based permissions. Node.js experience integrating APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, and third-party systems. Vercel or comparable deployment and production-support experience. Evidence of taking over, completing, or repairing an existing production application. Testing, debugging, documentation, and clear communication. Experience with internal dashboards, reconciliation, financial workflows, property technology, or booking platforms is helpful.

items.description: Job Description : We are hiring an experienced AI/OCR Engineer to design and build production-grade document intelligence and AI-assisted workflows for a complex digital platform. The role focuses on processing scanned documents, photographs, PDFs, digital documents, and multi-page files; extracting structured information; validating results; managing confidence levels; and integrating document-processing services into secure web, mobile, and backend workflows. This is not a chatbot-only, prompt-engineering, or research-only AI role. The position requires hands-on experience building reliable production OCR/document-processing systems. Key Responsibilities Design and maintain end-to-end document-processing pipelines. Implement document ingestion, preprocessing, OCR, classification, field extraction, normalization, validation, and result storage. Handle low-quality, rotated, blurred, handwritten, incomplete, and structurally inconsistent documents. Build structured data extraction from semi-structured and unstructured documents. Implement document classification and layout-aware extraction. Design confidence scoring and validation rules for extracted information. Build AI-assisted summarization, explanation, classification, and structured interpretation workflows. Reduce hallucination risk through grounded outputs, structured schemas, validation, and fallback behavior. Evaluate OCR, Document AI, and LLM implementations in production. Job Specification : Required Skills and Experience 4+ years of professional experience in Applied AI, Machine Learning, OCR, Document Intelligence, NLP, or production AI engineering. Strong production experience with Python. Experience building OCR and document-processing pipelines. Experience extracting structured information from semi-structured and unstructured documents. Experience integrating OCR, Document AI, and/or LLM services into production systems. Understanding of confidence scoring, validation, precision, recall, evaluation, and error analysis. Experience designing evaluation datasets and regression tests. Experience with REST APIs, asynchronous processing, queues, object storage, and backend integration. Understanding of data privacy and secure handling of sensitive information. Experience monitoring model or pipeline accuracy, latency, failures, and cost. Experience with CI/CD and production deployment. Strong problem-solving, technical communication, and English communication skills. Preferred Skills Azure AI Do
